modeling_decisions: Retain long continuous recessed fracture and chain of low lips. Reject concept oversized separate circular bowls, repetitive paving/columnar side walls and intense orange light; use four unequal low localized widened vent sections linked by continuously open narrow crack. Crack dark walls and deepest floor geometrically recessed. One integrated closed mesh, no floating lava cards/particles or overlapping boulders. No emissive texture.
